name: RAPP OS

endpoints./OS/api/dogfs.json: the console's exhaustive DOG index, regenerated by Jekyll on every build
endpoints./OS/api/fs.json: the desktop's curated DOG mount tree
endpoints./OS/api/apps.json: apps shown in the desktop dock
endpoints./OS/boot/boot.json: the boot record: POST checks, mounts, devices
endpoints./api/examples.json: the site's own static API, mounted as a character device

_: There is no server here. Every endpoint above is a file in a public git repo, which is the point: you can curl any of them, an agent can read them, and they are all versioned.
